fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Brochure/Brochure.cy.js#Brochure - Brochure [hi] — Brochure TC-BR-06: Download Brochure lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Brochure
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BR-06
**Title:** Download Brochure lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Brochure
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open the Brochure page, click Download Brochure, fill a valid name, an invalid (5-digit) mobile number, and leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown mobile-format and location-required validation messages are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Brochure page
2. Click Download Brochure to open its lead form
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city left empty
5. Verify the mobile-format and location validation messages are shown
